deviations.reason: The wireframe draws icons as text glyphs (plus, magnifier, triangle...); the app uses Tabler icons. A text difference that is only these glyphs is allowed.
A text glyph sits in a line box (about 20px tall); an SVG icon is its own height. Width and x still must match.
The wireframe is grayscale on purpose; the app uses Vanta color tokens. Structure (filled vs not) is still compared; hue is not.
The wireframe draws three gray dots for the window controls; the app uses the native macOS traffic lights.
Workbench tabs and palette rows are real tab and option widgets (roving arrows, aria-selected, aria-activedescendant); the wireframe draws plain buttons. Track W, owner to confirm.
A Tabler icon box replaces a text glyph whose advance differs per glyph, so a row title line is a few px wider or narrower when the title is the longest line. Track W.

Wireframe .code has no white-space:pre, so its multi-line diff, tree and terminal text collapses to one line; the build keeps the line breaks, which changes the block height and what sits under it. Track W, owner to confirm.
Wireframe rule .w1100 .badge{display:none} targets the sidebar rail but also hides Home's Needs you badge at 1100; the build keeps the badge visible. Track W, owner to confirm.

Owner-kept feature (restore track R1): the Hermes titlebar tools stay visible beside the wireframe's pane toggles: settings gear, layout editor, HUD, swap sidebars, right-sidebar toggle, and the sidebar toggle at every width with its unread badge. The wireframe draws only the drawer button at 800px.

Owner-kept feature (R1): the sidebar keeps the original Hermes list controls the wireframe does not draw: SESSIONS | BOTS tab strip, Search sessions field, Pinned and Sessions sections with the filter menu, date dividers, per-row menus, messaging groups, CRON JOBS section, and project lanes. Needs you stays as the Vanta addition.

Owner-kept feature (R1): the bottom-left row keeps the Hermes profile controls (home, + New profile, Import profile, ... Manage profiles) beside the settings gear; the wireframe footer is the gear only. There is no profile chip.

Owner-kept feature (R1): the slim Hermes status bar is visible by default (command center, backend health, workspace, agents, cron, webhooks, timers, context meter, approval mode, terminal toggle, version); the wireframe draws no status bar. Free-tier and gateway switcher are removed.
Owner-kept feature (R1): the nav row for New chat reads New session and Search is a field, as in Hermes (the New session row is also a drag source for splits).
